title: P1 fix: detection fails closed (not open) on filesystem errors
action: Fixes review finding #2 (P1, session worktree-concurrency-guard-review-20260724): plan.md's Test Matrix explicitly requires 'a corrupt/missing companion marker, or a broken symlink -- must fail closed on the concurrency+shared-target question... never silently allow because detection itself errored', but every helper in guards.mjs (hasGitNode's statSync catch, findNestedCheckoutDir's ancestor-climb continue-on-unresolvable-realpath) and bee-write-guard.mjs's top-level hook catch (line ~941, `return 0`) currently resolve an error to ALLOW. Fix ONLY the path that matters for this feature's guarantee: in bee-write-guard.mjs's dispatch, wrap the call to guards.isSharedNestedCheckoutTarget in its own try/catch so that if IT throws, the write is DENIED (not silently allowed via the outer catch-all) -- do not touch the hook's pre-existing general containment-check philosophy elsewhere in the file (that stays fail-open by established design, out of this fix's scope, matching this codebase's existing pattern for unrelated checks). Do NOT change hasGitNode/findNestedCheckoutDir's internal continue/false-on-error behavior for merely-nonexistent paths (a path that doesn't exist yet is not a detection ERROR, it's a legitimate 'nothing there' answer) -- only make an actual thrown exception from the primitive itself result in a deny at the call site. Prove red-first: a fixture where isSharedNestedCheckoutTarget is forced to throw (e.g. an unreadable/permission-denied nested .git, or inject a throwing stub in the test harness matching this file's existing buildThrowingGuardsFixture pattern) currently allows the write; after the fix it denies with a typed message.

truths: When guards.isSharedNestedCheckoutTarget throws, the write-guard hook DENIES the write (not silently allows it)
A legitimate 'nothing shared here' answer (path does not exist, no nested checkout) still ALLOWS exactly as before -- only an actual thrown exception changes behavior
All existing rows (65-82) stay green -- this fix must not change the verdict for any already-proven non-error case

Do not regress any of rows 65-82
